acceptanceCriteria: Create or duplicate an editable profile from a predefined system without modifying the catalog record or starting playback.
Retain and display the profile reference configuration; disclose when profile and selected-system references differ.
Support approved grouping and written/sounding pitch presentation while preserving the resolved sounding frequency and entry identity.
component: Profile creation and duplication from catalog systems, reference configuration, grouping, and pitch presentation.
componentsAffected: iPhone profile editor and catalog workflow
notes: Planning record only; implementation is not authorized.
The predefined source remains immutable; the user's resulting profile is editable. No automatic playback on create, duplicate, or selection.
rationale: Discovery becomes useful when a musician can safely turn a selected system into a reusable, editable reference profile.
testSteps: Create and duplicate from representative predefined systems; verify source immutability and local persistence after reload.
Exercise reference mismatch presentation and confirm rendered frequency follows the profile's retained reference.
Verify grouping and written/sounding labels preserve entry identity and resolved frequency on iPhone and Watch.

workItem.title: Implement profile creation and tuning workflows
